newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to address Congress on Feb. 4.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to address Congress on Feb. 4.

text.p: President Bill Clinton has been invited to make his annual State of the Union address to Congress on Tuesday, Feb. 4 at 9 p.m. EST (0200 GMT Wednesday, Feb. 5), it was announced on Wednesday.
House of Representatives Speaker Newt Gingrich and Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said in a joint statement that Clinton would also release his budget proposals to Congress on Feb. 6.
The president uses the nationally televised State of the Union address to announce his legislative agenda for the year.
Clinton will be inagurated for his second term on Jan. 20.
